meta.note: Canonical reproducible counts for the truth-lock branch, including the source-of-truth workflow introduced by this change. The listed commit is the inspected main baseline, not the eventual merge commit. scripts/audit/validate-source-of-truth.js recomputes metrics from whichever commit is checked out and fails on drift. Runtime and database values not refreshed on 2026-07-25 remain historical snapshots, not current public claims.

on_disk_unregistered.command: Tracked top-level artifact directories minus registered artifact manifests
on_disk_unregistered.note: api-server is backend infrastructure and is not counted as a customer-facing product vertical.

total_on_disk.command: Count unique tracked top-level children of artifacts/

domain_packages_dir.command: Count tracked top-level directories under packages/

shared_lib_packages.command: Count unique tracked top-level children of lib/

total_packages.command: packages/ top-level count plus lib/ top-level count
total_packages.note: packages/ (157 directories) + lib/ (53 directories) = 210. packages/proxy-routes.ts is a file and is not counted as a package.

apps.command: Count unique tracked top-level children of apps/

services.command: Count unique tracked top-level children of services/

workers.command: Count unique tracked top-level children of workers/

pg_table_call_sites.command: Count pgTable( call sites in tracked lib/db/src/schema/**/*.ts files
pg_table_call_sites.note: A source call-site count, not a claim about currently provisioned database tables.

migration_files.note: Includes duplicate sequence numbers from parallel branches; this is a file count, not an applied-migration count.

route_source_files.command: Count non-test source files under apps/, services/, and artifacts/api-server/ that contain a detected Express route declaration
route_source_files.note: Derived from declarations rather than /routes/ path names so router.ts, server.ts, and other route-bearing files are included.

handler_declarations.command: Count non-test get|post|put|patch|delete|use declarations on app/router and named Express Router receivers under apps/, services/, and artifacts/api-server/
handler_declarations.note: A static declaration count. It does not prove deployment, reachability, authentication, or HTTP 200 behavior.

rbac_roles.note: Retained as a historical documentation-consistency claim; it is not part of the automated v2 current-tree metric set.

workflows.note: Includes the source-of-truth workflow introduced by this truth-lock change.

registered_mobile_artifacts.command: Count registered artifact manifest paths containing mobile
registered_mobile_artifacts.note: No mobile artifact is registered in the current tracked artifacts tree.

registered.definition: A registered customer-facing domain artifact. A11oy is counted separately as the orchestration product.

declarations.definition: Declarations in the frozen Doctrine v11 Lean kernel at c7c0ba17.

unique_axioms.definition: Unique declared axioms in the frozen kernel; 15 raw occurrences with one duplicate.

tracked_sorries.definition: Tracked sorry obligations in the frozen kernel snapshot; not a count of locked-proven formulas.

locked_formulas.definition: The exact locked-proven set, separately enforced by the no-axiom Lean theorem locked_count_eight.

github_public_estate.verification: gh api --paginate 'orgs/szl-holdings/repos?per_page=100&type=all' filtered by visibility and archived
github_public_estate.note: The nine-public-repository target is a future disposition decision, not current state. No repository visibility was changed by this truth lock.

live_table_count.note: Schema applied via drizzle push (no __drizzle_migrations table); 730 is the final count after rollback test (dropped 6 tables) and forward-migration restore (+6) plus supplemental migration (+2 indexes, no new tables)

live_db.drizzle_migrations_tracker: ABSENT — schema was applied via drizzle push, not drizzle migrate

indexes.command: SELECT count(*) FROM pg_indexes WHERE schemaname = 'public'

fk_constraints.command: SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.table_constraints WHERE constraint_schema='public' AND constraint_type='FOREIGN KEY'

unique_constraints.command: SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.table_constraints WHERE constraint_schema='public' AND constraint_type='UNIQUE'

check_constraints.command: SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.table_constraints WHERE constraint_schema='public' AND constraint_type='CHECK'
check_constraints.note: Includes NOT NULL and pgEnum constraints generated by Drizzle ORM — not 5707 distinct business-rule validations

pk_constraints.command: SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.table_constraints WHERE constraint_schema='public' AND constraint_type='PRIMARY KEY'

pgTable_call_sites.note: Raw grep; may overcount re-exports. Live provisioned count is 730.

drizzle_sql_files.note: Updated 2026-04-25. Track 4 verification run (2026-04-21) recorded 115; canonical count is now 132 (database.migration_files.count) after +17 new migrations. This section reflects current filesystem state.

drizzle_journal_entries.note: Gaps are non-blocking; journal is self-consistent

hand_authored_migrations.note: Not tracked in __drizzle_migrations; separate apply path

orphaned_files_resolved.resolution: Registered as journal idx 91, 92, 93 with IF NOT EXISTS guards
